title: THE PARTY SEED
why: His yes to the party seed. NEW PARTY in the operator menu now also locks one seed and the sector for the night. Every DEMO run after it builds the same raid, the same layout, the same loot and the same golden enemy, so everyone who plays that night gets the same chance and the board is fair. The seed is picked the way a raid picks its own, so nothing else in the game moves, and it lasts until the party is twelve hours old or NEW PARTY is pressed again. The board page says SEEDED NIGHT with a four letter code, and the operator card shows the same code. A raid started with a seed of its own (a test, for one) still uses that seed.
now: NEW PARTY locks one seed for the night, so every demo run plays the same raid.
